name: Brain.fm
good_for: AI-generated functional music for focus, relaxation, and sleep
watch_out: No free tier — only a free trial; a paid subscription is required after the trial

name: Ecrett Music
good_for: Royalty-free AI-generated music for videos and commercial projects
watch_out: The cheaper $4.99/month Individual rate requires annual billing; monthly billing is $7.99/month

name: Fadr
good_for: Splitting songs into stems (vocals, drums, bass, melody) and AI-powered remixing
watch_out: Promo banners on the site advertise discounts — the price quoted is the standing list price, not a promo; no separate legal company name shown on the footer

name: Onyx
good_for: AI search across a team's documents, email, and apps, self-hosted or in Onyx cloud
watch_out: The $20/user/month rate is annual billing; enterprise pricing is custom and only a free trial (no free tier) is offered

name: Cline
price_from: Free for individuals (pay only for AI inference usage)
good_for: Autonomous AI coding agent inside VS Code that plans, writes, and edits code
watch_out: No subscription, but every AI action consumes inference credits you pay for — or bring your own model API keys

name: OpenHands
price_from: Free to run yourself (paid cloud also offered; price not listed on site)
good_for: Open-source AI software-development agents you run locally or self-host
watch_out: Only the free local/self-hosted tier has a listed price — the paid cloud plan's price is not shown on the pricing page

name: Komo
price_from: Free ($0 forever plan; paid credit plans also offered, prices not shown on page)
good_for: Everyday AI search with premium models, deep research, and people search
watch_out: Paid tiers are usage-based credits whose prices are not in the static page — only the $0 free plan price is shown; no separate legal company name shown on the footer
